netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
PMOS M2 n5 VDD n5 VDD
L Ls n3 VSS
L Ld VDD n4
C Ct1 n4 n5
C Cout n5 VOUT1
L Lsrc n3 n6
rationale: The proposed topology improves stability and gain by adding a source degeneration inductor to the NMOS transistor, which enhances input matching (S11) and reduces noise figure by increasing the effective source resistance, while also improving gain through better impedance matching. The inductor provides a high-impedance path at the signal frequency, increasing the gain and shifting the input impedance toward 50Ω, directly addressing the binding constraints of S11 and S21. The PMOS is kept as a current source to maintain biasing stability and reduce power consumption. This change is minimal in footprint and fits within the device budget.
